cls.name: Facility
cls.description: A physical site with capacity. Abstract: the network has only plants today, but distribution centres and contract manufacturers are the same kind of thing.

children.name: Plant
children.description: A manufacturing site. Carries capacity (work centres, hours, spare units) and inventory (days of cover, stock value) as properties, because both are 1:1 with the plant rather than entities in their own right.
